manager_rules: When kelvin_unrouted > 0, add directed LOCKED stubs for every SENSEC*_HI and SENSEC*_LO net from their INA238 sense pad to the corresponding shunt inner edge (same waypoint mechanism already applied to CAN_H/I2C_SCL/I2C_SDA), so FR has a forced entry point and routes into the tap window instead of across it.

Before launching every FR run, assert that the compiled stub manifest contains at least one entry for each net in every Kelvin pair (all nets matching /SENSEC*_HI and /SENSEC*_LO); if any Kelvin net is absent AND there is no matching compile_failure entry for it, inject a synthetic compile_failure for that net and ABORT the FR run with a clear error — do not route, because the Kelvin gate will fail deterministically and the compute is wasted. Only proceed when every Kelvin pair net is confirmed present in the stub manifest.

injections.rationale: kelvin_unrouted currently carries no injected penalty, so FR treats stranded Kelvin sense nets as ordinary ratlines.
